GRI 1: heading 6307 other made up articles

classification.rationale: The quilted moving blanket is a made-up textile article whose function is to protect furniture, not to provide warmth, so it is excluded from blankets of heading 6301 and falls in the residual heading 6307. NY N357875 (in force), a country-of-origin ruling on a furniture moving blanket, states the blanket is classified in 6307.90.9891. That statistical line is a current leaf.
